full_prompt_en: A square textured oil painting shows two women seated together on a bench against a weathered, nearly abstract urban backdrop. They occupy the center of the frame, with a broad cream colored wall above them and layered blue gray and ocher patches below. The woman on the left wears a black short sleeved dress and dark shoes; her light brown hair is gathered into a rounded shape. She turns her head right toward her companion, with one leg crossed over the other and pale hands resting close together in her lap. The woman on the right has light hair tied back and wears a mustard yellow jacket over darker clothing, an orange red skirt, and dark shoes. Her body faces the viewer more directly, though her head turns left, suggesting a quiet conversation. A warm yellow horizontal band behind their backs suggests the bench and divides the wall from the lower field. At the far left, two very small figures in blue and red walk through a light opening, establishing a distant public setting without detailed architecture. Black rectangular fragments and scratches interrupt the upper corners, while the foreground is built from broad scraped areas of faded turquoise, slate gray, pale cream, and brown. A dark vertical mark near the lower right provides a small counterweight to the seated pair. The figures are more carefully modeled than their surroundings, but their edges also break into the rough painted surface. Diffuse daylight keeps the upper wall and faces pale, while darker paint accumulates behind the bench and around the feet. The overall composition feels reflective and gently social, with intimate conversation suspended within an expansive, timeworn field of color.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形肌理油画描绘两名女子并坐在长椅上，身后是风化、几乎抽象的城市背景。她们位于画面中央，上方是一大片奶油色墙面，下方叠着蓝灰与赭黄色斑。左侧女子穿黑色短袖裙和深色鞋，浅棕头发收成圆润发型。她转头向右望着同伴，一条腿叠在另一条上，浅色双手靠在膝间。右侧女子把浅色头发束在后面，穿芥末黄外套、较暗的内搭、橙红色裙子和深色鞋。身体更直接地朝向观者，头却转向左侧，显出安静交谈的意味。两人背后一条暖黄色水平带暗示长椅，也把墙面与下方色场分开。最左侧，两名穿蓝色和红色的小人物走过一处浅色开口，建立远处公共空间，却没有细描建筑。黑色矩形碎片与刮痕打断上方两角，前景由淡青绿、板岩灰、浅奶油色和棕色的宽阔刮擦面组成。右下附近一条深色竖痕为坐着的两人提供细小平衡。人物比周围环境刻画得更仔细，但边缘也融进粗糙的油画表面。漫射日光使上方墙面和脸部保持浅色，较深颜料则聚在椅背之后及脚边。整体构图沉思而轻轻带有社交气息，让亲密对话悬在开阔、经历时间磨损的色彩场中。
style_prompt_en: Textured oil painting lays careful focal modeling over a broader abstract field of scraped, patched, and partially erased color. Cream, faded turquoise, slate blue, muted ocher, rust orange, and dense black are distributed in unequal rectangles and soft irregular smears. Thin scratches and broken dark marks interrupt the larger pale surfaces, giving them age and tactile depth. A compact central cluster is held by one warm horizontal band, while smaller accents at the far edges make the space feel open. Edges shift from descriptive near the focal point to frayed and unresolved in the surrounding field. Light is diffuse and high, preserving pale upper values without strong directional shadows. The lower area grows more layered and mottled, so the eye repeatedly moves between solid color blocks and worn translucent patches. The overall effect is contemplative and modern, balancing quiet human scale with a large weathered surface.
style_prompt_zh: 肌理油画把焦点处仔细的塑形放在更广阔的刮擦、补片与部分抹除的抽象色场之上。奶油色、褪色青绿、板岩蓝、低饱和赭黄、锈橙及浓黑以大小不均的矩形和柔软不规则擦痕分布。细刮线与断裂深色笔迹打断较大的浅色表面，带来年代感和触觉纵深。紧凑的中央聚合由一条暖色水平带托住，远缘更小的重音使空间显得开阔。边缘从焦点附近的描述性刻画，转为外围色场里磨散、未完全明确的形态。光线漫射而偏高，保留浅色上部明度，没有强烈定向阴影。下方区域更层叠、斑驳，因此视线不断在实色块与磨损的半透明色斑之间移动。整体效果沉静而现代，在安静的尺度感和宽阔的风化表面之间取得平衡。
theme_en: Two women talking on a bench in a weathered abstract city scene
theme_zh: 两名女子坐在长椅上交谈，身处斑驳抽象城市画面
name: Cathy Hegman
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
